title: Best Buy’s Black Friday sale begins Nov. 19
summary: Make the most of the holiday season with 10 days of Doorbusters and deals on this year’s hottest tech.
body_markdown:
By[Best Buy](https://corporate.bestbuy.com/)


November 17, 2026


## Make the most of the holiday season with 10 days of Doorbusters and deals on this year’s hottest tech, including a special gift card offer in stores only on Black Friday


It’s time for 10 days of Doorbusters and deals on the season’s most-wanted gifts. The official


[2026 Best Buy Black Friday Sale](https://www.bestbuy.com/black-friday) begins Thursday, Nov. 19, giving shoppers plenty of time to find something special for everyone on their lists. For shoppers heading to stores, there’s an extra reason to get there early: Best Buy will have a limited in-store only doorbuster offer on Black Friday, Nov. 27, that My Best Buy™ members won’t want to miss.


My Best Buy members can purchase a $100 Best Buy Gift Card for $60, a $40 savings. It’s free to sign up, plus they can use the gift card immediately to buy the next gift on their holiday list.


## Our biggest event of the season


The Black Friday Sale kicks off on Thursday, Nov. 19, with 10 days of Doorbusters and deals on some of the season’s most-wanted tech. Here’s a sneak peek:


- Save $250 on[Apple MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop](https://www.bestbuy.com/product/apple-macbook-air-13-inch-laptop-m5-chip-with-10-core-cpu-and-8-core-gpu-16gb-memory-512gb-ssd-midnight/JJGCQLKXL7/sku/6397846) (Sale price: $1049.00)


- Save $100 on[iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 17 Pro Max](https://www.bestbuy.com/product/apple-iphone-17-pro-max-256gb-cosmic-orange-unlocked/JJGCQLQZZX/sku/6473213) (Sale price: 1099.99)
- Save $240 on[TCL 65-inch TV](https://www.bestbuy.com/product/tcl-65-s4cf-series-4k-uhd-hdr-smart-tv-with-fire-tv-2026/J36QYTHZVP/sku/6687112) (Sale price: $229.99)
- Save $350 on[HP Omnibook 5 – 14” 2K OLED Touchscreen Laptop](https://www.bestbuy.com/product/hp-omnibook-5-14-2k-oled-touchscreen-laptop-intel-core-5-series-3-2026-8gb-memory-256gb-ssd-starlit-blue/J3KSW748W6/sku/6690110) (Sale price: $449.99)
- [Oura Ring 5](https://www.bestbuy.com/product/oura-ring-5-smart-ring-fitness-tracker-size-before-you-buy-with-or5-sizing-kit-size-8-stealth-2026/CT296X7JHW) as low as $299.99
- Save $229 on[Sony Wireless Noise Cancelling Over-the-Ear Headphones](https://www.bestbuy.com/product/sony-wh-1000xm5-wireless-noise-cancelling-over-the-ear-headphones-black/J7XSRH5CXG/sku/6505727) (Sale price: $169.00)
- Save $200 on[Samsung Galaxy S26 FE](https://www.bestbuy.com/product/samsung-galaxy-s26-fe-128gb-unlocked-graphite/JJGRF3V6G5/sku/6687704) (Sale price: $499.99)
- Save up to 50% on select Trading Cards
- Save up to 50% on[select Major Appliances.](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/promo/save-select-major-appliances)
- Save $300 on[Shark PowerDetect Speed Cordless Stick Vacuum Cleaner](https://www.bestbuy.com/product/shark-powerdetect-speed-cordless-stick-vacuum-cleaner-hepa-filtration-60-min-runtime-ia1121-ivory/JXJVXL847Y/sku/6689453) (Sale price: $199.99)
- Save $450 on[Insignia Refrigerator](https://www.bestbuy.com/product/insignia-30-in-wide-18-cu-ft-top-freezer-refrigerator-with-energy-star-certification-white/J2FPJK9S3W) (Sale price: $299.99)
- Save $60 on[Insignia 40″ LED Full HD Smart Fire TV](https://www.bestbuy.com/product/insignia-40-class-f40-series-led-full-hd-1080p-smart-fire-tv/J2FPJKSFFJ) (Sale price: 89.99)


And here’s a look at Thanksgiving through Cyber Week:


- **Limited in-store Doorbuster:** Members of the free My Best Buy program, as well as My Best Buy Plus™ and My Best Buy Total™ members, can purchase a $100 Best Buy Gift Card for $60 on Black Friday. At least 50 gift cards will be available at each store while supplies last, and customers can use the gift card toward eligible purchases¹.


- **Thanksgiving 24-Hour Flash Sale:** Take advantage of 24 hours of limited-time deals in the Best Buy app and on BestBuy.com while our stores are closed for Thanksgiving Day


2


.


- **Cyber Sunday and Monday:** The savings continue with our Cyber Sunday and Monday Sale Event, where shoppers can save up to 50%. Plus, they’ll have another opportunity to score a deal during a limited-time Cyber Monday Flash Sale


3


.


- **Cyber Week Deals:** The savings will continue Dec. 1-6 with more deals available throughout the week


4


.


From Nov. 19 through Dec. 6, Plus and Total members can earn double rewards on purchases


5


.


Members can find exclusive offers throughout the season, including spend-and-get promotions, reward offers and more.


Shoppers can also turn on alerts in the Best Buy app so they don’t miss out on major savings events and new offers throughout the holidays.


## Holiday store hours


- Nov. 19: 10 a.m. to 9 p.m.


- Nov. 20-Nov. 22: 9 a.m. to 9 p.m.


- Nov. 23-Nov. 25: 9 a.m. to 10 p.m.


- Thanksgiving Day, Nov. 26: Closed


- Black Friday, Nov. 27: 6 a.m. to 10 p.m.


- Nov. 28: 9 a.m. to 10 p.m.


- Cyber Sunday, Nov. 29: 9 a.m. to 9 p.m.


- Cyber Monday, Nov. 30: 10 a.m. to 10 p.m.


[Visit the local store page](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/store-locator) for the most up-to-date information


6


.


## Holiday shopping made easy


Best Buy is making it easier for customers to find the right gifts, shop with confidence and get their tech in the way that works best for them.


- **Holiday Gift Center:** The


[Holiday Gift Center](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/electronics/gift-ideas/abcat0010000.c?id=abcat0010000) is full of curated gift guides, expert recommendations and inspiration for everyone on their list.


- **Price Match:**[Holiday Price Match Guarantee](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/help-topics/price-match-guarantee/pcmcat290300050002.c?id=pcmcat290300050002) makes it so customers don’t have to worry about missing out on savings. If the price of an available product sold by Best Buy drops during the holiday season, we’ll match it


7


.


- **Returns and exchanges:** Most purchases made Oct. 30 through Dec. 31 can be


[returned through Jan. 15, 2027](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/help-topics/return-exchange-policy/pcmcat260800050014.c?id=pcmcat260800050014) . Plus and Total members have through Jan. 31, 2027, to return most purchases


8


.


- **Convenient ways to shop:** Customers can shop in stores, through the Best Buy app or on BestBuy.com, and discover products through Best Buy’s new


[TikTok Shop](https://shop.tiktok.com/us/store/best-buy/7494735489213761341?first_entrance_tt_scene=seo&btm_pre=a18064.b58037.c37359.d61812_i0&btm_transfer_id=9b62fb9f-98f4-4336-ac00-b8f0839cb2e5&enter_method=recommended_shops_shop_info&btm_pre_show_id=c05c2350-8c6c-4a60-be2b-c3c9c03c9bde&source=ecommerce_shoppingguide&first_entrance=google) . With in-store and curbside pickup, fast shipping and 24/7 Pickup Lockers at select stores, they can choose what works best for them.


## Can’t-miss experiences


There’s plenty of new tech to see and try at Best Buy this season, including:


- **Experience the next generation of TVs:** Best Buy is the only national retailer where customers can shop


[RGB LED TVs](https://corporate.bestbuy.com/2026/rgb-led-tv/) from Samsung, Sony, LG, TCL and Hisense, and experience incredible color and brightness from anywhere in the room.


- **Discover the latest from Meta:**[Meta Lab @ Best Buy](https://corporate.bestbuy.com/2026/meta-lab/) experiences in 50 stores give customers a hands-on way to explore Meta’s lineup of AI glasses and VR headsets through interactive demos, smart mirrors, personalized fittings and more.


- **More for gamers:**[Best Buy Gamers™](https://www.bestbuy.com/gamers) is a new online destination where gaming fans can explore personalized content, the latest tech, special offers, sweepstakes and experiences.

2 Flash Sale ends 11/26/26 at 11:59 p.m. CT. Limited quantities. No rainchecks. Offers subject to change. Prices valid during, but may start before and end after, the event.


3 Event ends 11/30/26 at 11:59 p.m. CT. Doorbusters end 11/29/26 at 11:59 p.m. CT. Limited quantities. No rainchecks. Offers subject to change. Prices valid during, but may start before and end after, the event.


4 Event ends 12/6/26 at 11:59 p.m. CT. Limited quantities. No rainchecks. Offers subject to change. Prices valid during, but may start before and end after, the event.


5 Offer valid through 12/6/2026 for new and existing My Best Buy Plus™ and My Best Buy Total™ members. Customer must have an active My Best Buy™ account and be signed into their associated account before qualifying purchase is made. Get 1 point per $1 spent (2% back in rewards) on qualifying Best Buy purchases. 2% back in points is inclusive of the 1% back in rewards you receive for being a Plus or Total member (1% + 1% = 2%). Rewards (points) will post to your loyalty account 2-3 weeks from purchase date, shipment date or delivery date. Qualifying purchase total does not include mobile devices purchased with monthly installment billing plans via AT&T or Verizon, tax, shipping or delivery fees, or Gift Cards. Additional limitations may apply. Additional limitations may apply. Subject to My Best Buy™ Program Terms, which can be found at BestBuy.com/MyBestBuyTerms.

7 Limitations apply. Excludes Marketplace Products. See BestBuy.com/PMG for details.
